job.job_description:
Role Summary

Looking for a Senior Quality Automation Engineer to test AI/GenAI applications used in Capital Markets (Investment Research, Banking, Sales & Trading). The role focuses on building automated testing frameworks, validating AI solutions, and ensuring high-quality software delivery.

Must-Have Skills




Experience

5+ years of QA/QE experience in Agile environments
Strong experience in test automation
Bachelor's degree in Technology/Computer Science or related field



Technical Skills

Strong Python programming skills
Experience using GenAI tools for test case generation or coding
Hands-on experience building and maintaining automation frameworks
Strong knowledge of:
End-to-End Testing
Integration Testing
Regression Testing
Data-driven Test Automation
Experience with CI/CD pipelines
Strong understanding of QA best practices and software quality



Responsibilities

Design, develop and maintain automated test frameworks
Perform both automation and manual testing
Review business requirements and create test strategies
Identify and mitigate testing risks
Mentor junior QA engineers
Collaborate with cross-functional teams



Soft Skills

Excellent communication skills
Strong organizational and time management skills
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines

Nice-to-Have Skills

Experience testing or validating AI/ML models
Experience developing or testing AI frameworks
Cloud platform experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Experience working in Capital Markets or Financial Services
